arxiv-2002-07821.title: Detection of Super-light Dark Matter Using Graphene Sensor
arxiv-2002-07821.creator: Doojin Kim, Jong-Chul Park, Kin Chung Fong, Gil-Ho Lee
arxiv-2002-07821.description: Abstract We propose a new dark-matter detection strategy that will enable the search of super-light dark matter m χ ≃ 0.1 m_{\chi}\simeq 0.1 keV, representing an improvement of the minimum detectable mass by more than three order of magnitude over the ongoing experiments.

arxiv-2110-00396.title: Quaternion Weyl Transform and some uniqueness results
arxiv-2110-00396.creator: Rupak Kumar Dalai, Somnath Ghosh and R.K. Srivastava
arxiv-2110-00396.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rupak Kumar Dalai, Somnath Ghosh and R.K. Srivastava. In this article, we study the boundedness and several properties of the quaternion Wigner transform. Using the quaternion Wigner transform as a tool, we define the quaternion Weyl transform (QWT) and prove that the QWT is compact for a certain class of symbols in L r ​ ( ℝ 4 , ℚ ) L^{r}\left(\mathbb{R}^{4},\mathbb{Q}\right) with 1 ≤ r ≤ 2 .

arxiv-2209-02647.description: Abstract Mn 3 Sn is a non-collinear antiferromagnetic quantum material that exhibits a magnetic Weyl semimetallic state and has great potential for efficient memory devices. High-quality epitaxial c c -plane Mn 3 Sn thin films have been grown on a sapphire substrate using a Ru seed layer.

arxiv-2211-03092.creator: Yakov Itin
arxiv-2211-03092.description: Abstract A variational derivative of a Lagrangian with regard to the metric tensor is used in classical field models to define Hilbert’s energy-momentum tensor for a matter field. In solid-state physics, constitutive relationships between fundamental field variables are a topic that is covered by a broad variety of models.

arxiv-2512-12454.creator: R. Abou Yassine 7,14 , J. Adamczewski-Musch 6 , C. Asal 9 , M. Becker 12 , A. Belounnas 14 , A. Blanco 2 , C. Blume 9,6,e , L. Chlad 15,g , P. Chudoba g , I. Ciepał 4 , J. Dreyer 8 , W.A. Esmail 6 , L. Fabbietti 11 , H. Floersheimer 7 , J. Förtsch 18 , P. Fonte 2,a , J. Friese 11 , I. Fröhlich 9 , T
arxiv-2512-12454.description: Abstract We present the first observation of 3 Λ \Lambda H and 4 Λ \Lambda H in Ag+Ag collisions at s NN \sqrt{\text{s\textsubscript{NN}}} = 2.55 GeV, emitted around mid-rapidity. The hypernuclei are reconstructed via their two-body decay channels and identified through their weak-decay topology, employing an artificial neural network for enhanced discrimination.

pmc-10647601.title: Glenohumeral Pathologies following Primary Anterior Traumatic Shoulder Dislocation—Comparison of Magnetic Resonance Arthrography and Arthroscopy
pmc-10647601.creator: Oliver Holub, Jakob E Schanda, Sandra Boesmueller, Marion Tödtling, Alexander Talaska, Rudolf M Kinsky, Rainer Mittermayr, Christian Fialka, William G Blakeney, Markus Kuster
pmc-10647601.description: Background: We assessed intraarticular injuries in patients after primary anterior traumatic shoulder dislocation by comparing magnetic resonance arthrography (MRA) results with concomitant arthroscopic findings. Methods: All patients with primary traumatic shoulder dislocation who underwent arthroscopic surgery between 2001 and 2020 with preoperative MRA were included in this study. MRA was retrospectively compared with arthroscopic findings.

pmc-10714758.title: Alleviation of DSS-induced colitis via bovine colostrum-derived extracellular vesicles with microRNA let-7a-5p is mediated by regulating Akkermansia and β-hydroxybutyrate in gut environments
pmc-10714758.creator: Daye Mun, Minkyoung Kang, Minhye Shin, Hye Jin Choi, An Na Kang, Sangdon Ryu, Tatsuya Unno, Brighton E. Maburutse, Sangnam Oh, Younghoon Kim
pmc-10714758.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is an inflammatory disease caused by the interaction of environmental and genetic factors, including diet and microbiota. Recent studies have suggested the effects of extracellular vesicles (EVs) on controlling host intestinal immune responses, although the specified mechanisms have not yet been fully elucidated.

pmc-12416874.title: Dengue Epidemiology in 7 Southeast Asian Countries: 24-Year, Retrospective, Multicountry Ecological Study
pmc-12416874.creator: Shun-Long Weng, Fang-Yu Hung, Sung-Tse Li, Bo-Huang Liou, Chun-Yan Yeung, Yu-Lin Tai, Yi-Hsuan Wu, Ya-Ning Huang, Nan-Chang Chiu, Liang-Yen Lin, Hsin Chi, Chien-Yu Lin
pmc-12416874.description: BackgroundDengue fever remains the most significant vector-borne disease in Southeast Asia, imposing a substantial burden on public health systems. Global warming and increased international mobility may exacerbate the disease’s prevalence. Furthermore, the unprecedented COVID-19 pandemic may have influenced the epidemiological patterns of dengue.ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate epidemiological changes in dengue incidence in Southeast Asia.

pmc-13075164.title: Morphological Traits Shape Foraging Scale but Not Precision: Divergent Responses of Four Tree Species to Water and Nutrient Heterogeneity
pmc-13075164.creator: Liuduan Wei, Tianxin Dong, Liufeng Lan, Jian Lin, Xianwen Li, Miao Yu, Chengyang Xu
pmc-13075164.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Soil nutrients and water are often distributed heterogeneously in space, yet how plant roots forage in response to such heterogeneity and how their strategies relate to functional traits remain poorly understood. Here, we conducted an indoor pot experiment manipulating water and nutrient supply in both homogeneous and heterogeneous patch patterns using seedlings of four tree species, focusing on root functional traits and foraging strategies.

pmc-13133402.title: Synthesis and evaluation of novel nanocomposites for removal of zinc ions from aqueous solutions
pmc-13133402.creator: Nada S Al-Kadhi, Saad A Aljlil, Hesham H El-Feky, Ehab A Abdelrahman
pmc-13133402.description: Zn(II) contamination in aquatic systems poses significant risks to environmental safety and public health. In this study, BaCO3/BaAl2O4/C nanocomposites, denoted BA600 and BA800, were synthesized by a facile Pechini sol-gel route at 600 and 800 °C and evaluated for Zn(II) removal from aqueous solutions.

pmc-13402580.title: Targeting FoxO1/3a, NF-κB, and mTOR signaling attenuates muscle atrophy in sepsis
pmc-13402580.creator: Donglin Fu, Min Zhou, Yingxiao Zhang, Pan Cheng, Yue Shu, Qian Xiao, Meng Zhang
pmc-13402580.description: Sepsis frequently leads to skeletal muscle atrophy, but its molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Using a mouse model of cecal ligation and puncture and LPS-treated C2C12 myotubes, we found that sepsis activates autophagy, the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS), and calpain pathways, resulting in muscle wasting and functional decline. These changes were linked to upregulated FoxO1/3a and NF-κB signaling and suppressed mTOR activity.
